cli.update_discovery.check.summary.role: Concise CLI discovery summary shown when no newer release is offered or discovery is unavailable.
cli.update_discovery.check.summary.tone: Factual, concise; observation is not a guarantee of registry freshness.

placeholders.source: Fixed technical source enum: live, cache-fallback, unavailable, cache-ttl, unknown.
placeholders.version: Bounded metadata version or a dash when absent.
placeholders.readiness: Fixed technical readiness enum: ready, pending, unavailable, cached-ready, unknown.
placeholders.age: Cache age in seconds with technical s suffix, or a dash when unknown.

cli.update_discovery.check.cached_unveri.role: Network failure refusal after a forced CLI check could only recover old local metadata. No installer or service refresh has run.
cli.update_discovery.check.cached_unveri.tone: Honest and actionable, without claiming the cached version is latest.

placeholders.version: Bounded version from the local readiness-checked cache.

cli.update_discovery.check.ahead.role: CLI no-upgrade result when installed is strictly newer than the currently observed live PyPI version. Does not claim publication readiness of the installed build.
cli.update_discovery.check.ahead.tone: Neutral and factual; never suggest a downgrade.

placeholders.latest: Observed live PyPI version identifier, not a guarantee of registry freshness.
